info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Carrental Reservations Cancel-v1-spec
info.description: The Cancel Car Rental Reservations API enables authorized users to effectively cancel existing car rental reservations. This endpoint allows for the seamless management of reservation statuses, ensuring that customers can modify their plans as needed. Typical consumers of this API include rental agency staff and booking management systems that require real-time updates on reservation availability. By facilitating timely cancellations, this API enhances customer service and operational flexibility for car rental businesses.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to cancel an existing reservation. Ensure that the reservation ID is provided in the request to successfully process the cancellation.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to cancel an existing reservation. It should contain the necessary details to identify the reservation that needs to be canceled.

200.description: The reservation has been successfully canceled.

DeleteCarrentalReservationsCancelRequest.description: A JSON object used as the request body for canceling a reservation operation.

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the cancellation request.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the cancellation request.

state.description: The current state of the cancellation process.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the cancellation request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional context about the cancellation operation.

DeleteCarrentalReservationsCancelRespons.description: Response schema for successful cancellation of a reservation.

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the cancellation request.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the cancellation request was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Information regarding the audit trail of the cancellation operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the duration of processing the cancellation request.

schema.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.
